sys_script_include.description:
Invokes the "Order Complaint Triage Assistant" GenAI prompt config (sys_id 1766556dc3d04f41b54dda8d5e523b3f) for a given sn_customerservice_case record, parses the free-text output, and returns a structured result containing: the suggested complaint category, an urgency score (1-10), and a needs_manual_review flag.
Confidence signal: The GenAI config uses unstructured text output (structured_output_enabled=false), so there is no native confidence percentage. As a proxy this engine treats the response as LOW CONFIDENCE — and sets needs_manual_review=true — when the output text does not contain one of the nine recognised category keywords. This is documented in the returned object's confidence_note field.
Called by: the "AI Triage on Case Insert" Business Rule (sys_script).
sys_script_include.name: CaseTriageEngine
